quality.review_scope: Independent R1 full-main source audit plus accepted R2 delta closure. Five-page main only; SI and cited references unreviewed. Presentation pending; publisher permission for displayed source figures unverified. No unit cell or atomic-coordinate model reported.
missing_fields: Matching Supporting Information is not present in the screened-pass input and was not used; XRD and UV–vis details referenced only there are not imported.
Monkey-grass botanical identity, mass basis, drying procedure and moisture are unreported.
Autoclave heating ramp, internal pressure, headspace, agitation and cooling profile are unreported.
The 4500 and 12000 rpm centrifugation speeds and 10 min wording do not establish separate per-speed durations, step order or retained fraction.
No full crystalline phase model, unit-cell parameters or atomic coordinates/CIF for the N-CQD product are reported in the main article.
No zeta-potential medium, TEM particle count, histogram bin definitions or assay iodide-source salt is identified.
No isolated dry product mass, stated yield denominator or final stored batch identifier.
Exact chemical group assignments and full XPS/O1s interpretation partly refer to Supporting Information and are not extended beyond the main article.
Table 1 tap- and lake-water iodide recovery values are available in the displayed source table; they are not yet structured as individual measurements in this draft.
conflicts: Centrifugation is stated as 4500 and 12000 rpm for 10 min; source wording is retained without assigning a 10 min duration to each speed.
requested_tasks: Independent audit of all source claims, quantities, units and figure-to-sample bindings.
Verify one synthesis recipe–structure pair only; do not count assay conditions as additional synthesis outcomes.
Review the crop against Figure 1 and confirm image provenance; permission remains unverified.
Validate additive N-CQDs hub/Reader presentation, chemical renderer, source registry, schema and privacy before any integration.
